name.fr-FR: Défense de l’Histoire des variations contre la réponse de M. Basnage
name.en-US: Defence of the History of the Variations against the Reply of M. Basnage
name.pt-BR: Defesa da História das variações contra a resposta do Sr. Basnage

description.fr-FR: Réponse de Bossuet au pasteur Jacques Basnage, qui avait défendu la Réforme contre l’Histoire des variations : la preuve par les variations et la succession de la vraie Église. Publié en 1691. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Bossuet’s reply to the pastor Jacques Basnage, who had defended the Reformation against the History of the Variations: the argument from variations and the succession of the true Church. Published in 1691. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Resposta de Bossuet ao pastor Jacques Basnage, que defendera a Reforma contra a História das variações: a prova pelas variações e a sucessão da verdadeira Igreja. Publicado em 1691. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XV, page 011. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
